title.narrative: UAE National MRV Framework

description.narrative: In line with the UAE Green Agenda 2015-2030 and the National Climate Change Plan 2017-2050, the UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) further progressed with the development of the UAE Air Quality Strategy 2021-2031 and the National Framework for Actions on Climate Change Adaptation in 2020. Furthermore, the Government has updated its NDCs in support of the global action to mitigate climate impacts in line with the aims of the UNFCCC and the Paris Agreement.
